description: A question the agent cannot answer from memory, with one tool available
notes: The task the first one does not cover: whether the agent reaches for the tool it has. `act` asks the model to pick a tool or return null, and the run is graded on tool_trajectory_recall — the reference names web-search and the trial has to make that call and have it succeed. Nothing is rigged: the tool is registered, the question is one no seeded fact answers, and the prompt says a tool may be selected. Retrieval is still the vector path, for the same reason memory-recall-001 is: the seed writes no :Fact, so expandFromSeeds has nothing to return. `requires` names the axes on which that grading means anything: the stub model's selectTool returns null for every input, so a 0 scored there is a property of the fixture rather than of the agent, and the harness skips the task instead of averaging it in. It is a set rather than `live` alone so a replayed run — P1-B — needs no edit here.
